title: crispy all right
text: crispy all right. I don't like these sheets, they were so uncomfortable. I will not try them again, I tried washing them hoping they wouldn't stay so crispy but they didn't change.  On the other hand, I guess if you love crispy these are the sheets for you. The only thing I loved about them is the deep pockets, they stay on the bed just fine.
